```{r constants}
project_dir <- "/home/rstudio/project"
prep_dir    <- file.path(project_dir, "data/01_prepared")
eval_dir    <- file.path(project_dir, "data/04_evaluation")

DATASET   <- "flchain"
N_LEVELS  <- c(168L, 312L, 500L, 929L, 2000L, 2982L, 6524L)
B_ITER    <- 1000L
ALPHA_REF <- 0.05

SUBSAMPLE_BASE_SEED <- 2000000L

DP_SLOT       <- c(40L, 41L, 42L, 43L, 44L, 45L, 4L)
DP_LEVEL_BASE <- 42L + 100000L * DP_SLOT

SE_UNIDENTIFIED <- 10

FIXED_DENOM <- c("kappa", "creatinine", "mgus")

RSE_INFLATED <- 1.5

VARS <- c("age", "sexM", "sample.yr", "kappa", "lambda", "creatinine", "mgus")

CHUNK_SIZE <- 25L
```

```{r bounds-check}
bound_chk <- map_dfr(names(TYPES), function(v) {
  b <- BOUNDS[[v]]
  if (TYPES[[v]] == "continuous") {
    tibble(変数 = v, 型 = "continuous",
           `境界 下` = b[1], `境界 上` = b[2],
           `実測 min` = min(full_data[[v]]), `実測 max` = max(full_data[[v]]),
           `範囲 range_j` = diff(b),
           内包 = min(full_data[[v]]) >= b[1] && max(full_data[[v]]) <= b[2])
  } else {
    tibble(変数 = v, 型 = TYPES[[v]],
           `境界 下` = NA_real_, `境界 上` = NA_real_,
           `実測 min` = NA_real_, `実測 max` = NA_real_, `範囲 range_j` = NA_real_,
           内包 = all(as.character(full_data[[v]]) %in% as.character(b)))
  }
})
bound_chk %>% kable(caption = "クリッピング境界と実測範囲（全 7 水準で共通に使う）", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

stopifnot(nrow(bound_chk) == Q_FL, !anyNA(bound_chk$内包), all(bound_chk$内包))
cat("全 7 共変量で境界が実測範囲を内包 ✅ → 部分標本でもクリッピングは恒等写像であり、",
    "ε=∞ の摂動はベースラインと厳密に一致する\n")
```

```{r seed-space}
n_eps_all <- length(EPSILON_VALUES)

dp_seeds_of <- function(L) as.integer(outer(seq_len(n_eps_all) - 1L, seq_len(B_ITER),

dp_by_level <- lapply(seq_along(N_LEVELS), dp_seeds_of)

  length(dp_by_level[[L_FULL]]) == n_eps_all * B_ITER,

)

EXISTING_SEED_MAX <- 3990005L

stopifnot(

            min(dp_by_level[[L_FULL]]), max(dp_by_level[[L_FULL]]), DATASET, length(main_seeds)))

            min(unlist(dp_by_level[other])), max(unlist(dp_by_level[other])), EXISTING_SEED_MAX, sub_range[2]))
```

```{r sim-runner}
run_paired_sim <- function(full_data, n_levels, b_iter, eps_values, sub_base_seed, dp_level_base,
                           dataset, vars, n_workers, chunk_size, seed_stride) {
  callr::r(
    function(full_data, n_levels, b_iter, eps_values, sub_base_seed, dp_level_base,
             dataset, vars, n_workers, chunk_size, seed_stride) {
      Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS = "1", OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = "1",
                 MKL_NUM_THREADS = "1", VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS = "1",
                 RCPP_PARALLEL_NUM_THREADS = "1")
      library(survival); library(dplyr); library(furrr)
      source("/home/rstudio/project/main/02_dp_mechanisms/R/dp_input_perturbation_phase1.R")
      source("/home/rstudio/project/main/03_simulation/R/dp_fast.R")
      source("/home/rstudio/project/main/03_simulation/R/simulation_engine.R")

      bounds <- CLIPPING_BOUNDS[[dataset]]
      types  <- COVARIATE_TYPES[[dataset]]
      cox_fm <- COX_FORMULAS[[dataset]]
      n_eps  <- length(eps_values)
      nv     <- length(vars)
      cont_vars  <- names(types)[unlist(types) == "continuous"]
      event_rate <- mean(full_data$status == 1L)
      idx_event  <- which(full_data$status == 1L)
      idx_cens   <- which(full_data$status == 0L)

      n_chunk <- ceiling(b_iter / chunk_size)
      tasks <- expand.grid(level_idx = seq_along(n_levels), chunk = seq_len(n_chunk))
      tasks$n_sub <- n_levels[tasks$level_idx]
      tasks <- tasks[order(-tasks$n_sub), , drop = FALSE]

      if (n_workers <= 0L) plan(sequential) else plan(multisession, workers = n_workers)
      out <- future_map(seq_len(nrow(tasks)), function(k) {
        L   <- tasks$level_idx[k]
        n_t <- n_levels[L]
        n_e <- round(n_t * event_rate)
        its <- seq.int((tasks$chunk[k] - 1L) * chunk_size + 1L,
                       min(tasks$chunk[k] * chunk_size, b_iter))
        base_l <- vector("list", length(its))
        dp_l   <- vector("list", length(its))
        sd_l   <- vector("list", length(its))

        for (ii in seq_along(its)) {
          it <- its[ii]
          set.seed(sub_base_seed + L * 100000L + it)
          sel <- sort(c(sample(idx_event, n_e), sample(idx_cens, n_t - n_e)))
          dat <- full_data[sel, , drop = FALSE]

          warns <- character(0)
          fb <- withCallingHandlers(
            coxph(cox_fm, data = dat),
            warning = function(w) { warns <<- c(warns, conditionMessage(w)); invokeRestart("muffleWarning") }
          )
          bb <- coef(fb); sb <- sqrt(diag(vcov(fb)))
          base_l[[ii]] <- data.frame(
            level_idx = L, iter = it, variable = vars,
            beta_base = unname(bb[vars]), se_base = unname(sb[vars]),
            base_warn = length(warns) > 0,
            n_mgus = sum(dat$mgus == 1L), n_event = sum(dat$status == 1L),
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names = NULL)
          sd_l[[ii]] <- data.frame(
            level_idx = L, iter = it, src_var = cont_vars,
            sd_x = vapply(cont_vars, function(v) sd(dat[[v]]), numeric(1)),
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names = NULL)

          bm <- matrix(NA_real_, n_eps, nv); sm <- bm; cv <- logical(n_eps)
          for (e in seq_len(n_eps)) {
            set.seed(dp_level_base[L] + (e - 1L) * seed_stride + it)
            pert <- perturb_covariates_phase1_fast(dat, bounds, eps_values[e], types)
            r <- tryCatch({
              f <- coxph(cox_fm, data = pert)
              list(ok = TRUE, b = coef(f), s = sqrt(diag(vcov(f))))
            }, warning = function(w) {
              f <- suppressWarnings(coxph(cox_fm, data = pert))
              list(ok = FALSE, b = coef(f), s = sqrt(diag(vcov(f))))
            }, error = function(e2) list(ok = FALSE, b = NULL, s = NULL))
            cv[e] <- isTRUE(r$ok)
            if (!is.null(r$b)) {
              nm <- intersect(names(r$b), vars)
              bm[e, match(nm, vars)] <- r$b[nm]
              sm[e, match(nm, vars)] <- r$s[nm]
            }
          }
          dp_l[[ii]] <- data.frame(
            level_idx = L, iter = it,
            eps_idx  = rep(seq_len(n_eps), times = nv),
            variable = rep(vars, each = n_eps),
            beta_dp = as.vector(bm), se_dp = as.vector(sm),
            converged = rep(cv, times = nv),
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names = NULL)
        }
        list(base = do.call(rbind, base_l),
             dp   = do.call(rbind, dp_l),
             sdx  = do.call(rbind, sd_l))
      }, .options = furrr_options(seed = FALSE, chunk_size = 1L))
      plan(sequential)

      list(base = dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(out, `[[`, "base")),
           dp   = dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(out, `[[`, "dp")),
           sdx  = dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(out, `[[`, "sdx")))
    },
    args = list(full_data = full_data, n_levels = n_levels, b_iter = b_iter,
                eps_values = eps_values, sub_base_seed = sub_base_seed,
                dp_level_base = dp_level_base, dataset = dataset, vars = vars,
                n_workers = n_workers, chunk_size = chunk_size, seed_stride = seed_stride)
  )
}
```

```{r run-sim}
CPU_FRACTION <- 0.7
N_WORKERS <- max(1L, as.integer(floor(parallel::detectCores() * CPU_FRACTION)))

env_int <- function(nm) {
  v <- Sys.getenv(nm, "")
  if (!nzchar(v)) return(NULL)
  n <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(v))
  stopifnot(!is.na(n), n >= 0L)
  n
}
if (!is.null(w <- env_int("B2_N_WORKERS"))) {
  stopifnot(w <= as.integer(floor(parallel::detectCores() * CPU_FRACTION)))
  N_WORKERS <- w
  cat(sprintf("⚠️ B2_N_WORKERS=%d による上書き（並列度不変性の検証用）\n", N_WORKERS))
}
SEED_STRIDE <- B_ITER
if (!is.null(b <- env_int("B2_B_ITER"))) {
  stopifnot(b >= 1L, b <= B_ITER)
  B_ITER <- as.integer(b)
  cat(sprintf("⚠️ B2_B_ITER=%d による上書き（並列度不変性の検証用。本番は %d。刻み幅は %d のまま）\n",
              B_ITER, SEED_STRIDE, SEED_STRIDE))
}
stopifnot(SEED_STRIDE >= B_ITER)
B2_OVERRIDE <- !is.null(env_int("B2_N_WORKERS")) || !is.null(env_int("B2_B_ITER"))
if (B2_OVERRIDE) {
  eval_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "data/variants",
                        sprintf("fpr_subsampling_w%d_b%d", N_WORKERS, B_ITER))
  dir.create(eval_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf("⚠️ 上書きが有効なので出力先を %s に切り替える（本番の data/04_evaluation は触らない）\n", eval_dir))
}

t0 <- Sys.time()
sim <- run_paired_sim(
  full_data = full_data, n_levels = N_LEVELS, b_iter = B_ITER,
  eps_values = EPSILON_VALUES, sub_base_seed = SUBSAMPLE_BASE_SEED,
  dp_level_base = DP_LEVEL_BASE, dataset = DATASET, vars = VARS, seed_stride = SEED_STRIDE,
  n_workers = N_WORKERS, chunk_size = CHUNK_SIZE
)
elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "mins"))
saveRDS(sim, file.path(eval_dir, "fpr_subsampling_raw.rds"))

lv <- tibble(level_idx = seq_along(N_LEVELS), n_target = N_LEVELS)
baseline_tbl <- sim$base %>%
  left_join(lv, by = "level_idx") %>%
  mutate(estimable = !is.na(beta_base) & is.finite(se_base) & se_base > 0,
         z_base = beta_base / se_base,
         p_base = 2 * pnorm(-abs(z_base)),
         identified = estimable & se_base < SE_UNIDENTIFIED,
         sig_base = identified & p_base < ALPHA_REF)
dp_tbl <- sim$dp %>%
  left_join(lv, by = "level_idx") %>%
  mutate(epsilon = EPSILON_VALUES[eps_idx],
         z_dp = beta_dp / se_dp,
         p_dp = 2 * pnorm(-abs(z_dp)),
         sig_dp = p_dp < ALPHA_REF)
sd_tbl <- sim$sdx %>% left_join(lv, by = "level_idx")

n_fits <- length(N_LEVELS) * B_ITER * (1L + length(EPSILON_VALUES))
cat(sprintf("完了: %s 回の当てはめ（DP %s + ベースライン %s）/ %d ワーカー / %.1f 分（%.1f 万回/分）\n",
            format(n_fits, big.mark = ","),
            format(length(N_LEVELS) * B_ITER * length(EPSILON_VALUES), big.mark = ","),
            format(length(N_LEVELS) * B_ITER, big.mark = ","),
            N_WORKERS, elapsed, n_fits / elapsed / 1e4))

NOT_EST <- baseline_tbl %>% filter(!estimable)
stopifnot(
  nrow(baseline_tbl) == length(N_LEVELS) * B_ITER * length(VARS),
  nrow(dp_tbl) == length(N_LEVELS) * B_ITER * length(EPSILON_VALUES) * length(VARS),
  !anyNA(baseline_tbl$beta_base[baseline_tbl$estimable]),
  !anyNA(baseline_tbl$se_base[baseline_tbl$estimable]),
  all(baseline_tbl$se_base[baseline_tbl$estimable] > 0),
  nrow(NOT_EST) == 0L || all(NOT_EST$variable == "mgus")
)
cat(sprintf("ベースライン %s 行 / DP %s 行 ✅（期待どおり）\n",
            format(nrow(baseline_tbl), big.mark = ","), format(nrow(dp_tbl), big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf("係数が推定できなかったセル %s 件（%.2f%%）。すべて mgus で、部分標本に陽性者が 0 名だった反復である\n",
            format(nrow(NOT_EST), big.mark = ","), 100 * nrow(NOT_EST) / nrow(baseline_tbl)))
```

```{r subsample-check}
sub_diag <- baseline_tbl %>%
  distinct(level_idx, iter, n_target, n_event, n_mgus) %>%
  mutate(event_rate = n_event / n_target)

stopifnot(
  nrow(sub_diag) == length(N_LEVELS) * B_ITER,
  !anyNA(sub_diag$event_rate),
  all(abs(sub_diag$event_rate - EVENT_RATE) < 1 / min(N_LEVELS))
)
cat(sprintf("部分標本 %s 個（%d 水準 × %s 反復）✅ イベント率のずれは最大 %.5f\n",
            format(nrow(sub_diag), big.mark = ","), length(N_LEVELS),
            format(B_ITER, big.mark = ","), max(abs(sub_diag$event_rate - EVENT_RATE))))

sub_diag %>%
  group_by(n_target) %>%
  summarise(`反復数` = n(), `イベント数` = first(n_event), `イベント率` = first(event_rate),
            `mgus 陽性 最小` = min(n_mgus), `mgus 陽性 中央` = median(n_mgus),
            `mgus 陽性 最大` = max(n_mgus), .groups = "drop") %>%
  kable(caption = paste("水準別の部分標本の内訳。イベント率は全データの", sprintf("%.4f", EVENT_RATE),
                        "を保っている。mgus は有病率", sprintf("%.2f%%", 100 * MGUS_PREV),
                        "の希少な二値共変量であり、小標本では陽性が数名にとどまる。"), digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

full_lv <- which(N_LEVELS == max(N_LEVELS))
fb <- baseline_tbl %>% filter(level_idx == full_lv)
stopifnot(
  n_distinct(fb$beta_base[fb$variable == "age"]) == 1L,
  all(fb$n_event == sum(full_data$status == 1L)),
  all(fb$n_mgus == sum(full_data$mgus == 1L))
)
cat(sprintf("n=6524 の %s 反復はいずれも全データと同一（ベースライン β が 1 種類のみ）✅\n",
            format(B_ITER, big.mark = ",")))
```

```{r identity-eps-inf}
inf_chk <- dp_tbl %>%
  filter(is.infinite(epsilon)) %>%
  inner_join(baseline_tbl %>% select(level_idx, iter, variable, beta_base, se_base, estimable),
             by = c("level_idx", "iter", "variable")) %>%
  mutate(d_beta = abs(beta_dp - beta_base), d_se = abs(se_dp - se_base))
inf_ok <- inf_chk %>% filter(estimable)

stopifnot(
  nrow(inf_chk) == length(N_LEVELS) * B_ITER * length(VARS),
  !anyNA(inf_ok$d_beta), !anyNA(inf_ok$d_se),
  max(inf_ok$d_beta) < 1e-12, max(inf_ok$d_se) < 1e-12,
  all(is.na(inf_chk$beta_dp) == !inf_chk$estimable)
)
cat(sprintf("ε=∞ の %s セル（推定できた %s セル）で β・SE がベースラインと一致（最大差 %g、%s）✅\n",
            format(nrow(inf_chk), big.mark = ","), format(nrow(inf_ok), big.mark = ","),
            max(inf_ok$d_beta, inf_ok$d_se),
            if (max(inf_ok$d_beta, inf_ok$d_se) == 0) "厳密に 0" else "倍精度の丸め誤差の範囲"))
cat("推定できなかったセルは ε=∞ 側でも同じく推定できない（欠損の型が一致）✅\n")
```

```{r identification}
sep <- baseline_tbl %>% filter(estimable, !identified)
id_max   <- max(baseline_tbl$se_base[baseline_tbl$identified])
unid_min <- if (nrow(sep) > 0) min(sep$se_base) else Inf
stopifnot(id_max < SE_UNIDENTIFIED, unid_min > SE_UNIDENTIFIED)
cat(sprintf("識別済みの SE の最大 %.4f < 閾値 %g < 分離した SE の最小 %.1f（隔たり %.0f 倍）✅\n",
            id_max, SE_UNIDENTIFIED, unid_min, unid_min / id_max))
cat("→ 閾値をこの隔たりの間のどこに置いても同じ集合が得られる。閾値は恣意的ではない\n")

unid <- baseline_tbl %>% filter(!identified)
stopifnot(all(unid$variable == "mgus"))
cat(sprintf("評価できない係数は %s 件（全 %s 件の %.2f%%）、すべて mgus ✅ 内訳: 推定不能 %s 件 / 分離 %s 件\n",
            format(nrow(unid), big.mark = ","), format(nrow(baseline_tbl), big.mark = ","),
            100 * nrow(unid) / nrow(baseline_tbl),
            format(nrow(NOT_EST), big.mark = ","), format(nrow(sep), big.mark = ",")))

id_by_n <- baseline_tbl %>%
  group_by(n_target) %>%
  summarise(`mgus 陽性 0 名で推定不能` = sum(!estimable),
            `分離で識別されない` = sum(estimable & !identified),
            `評価できない反復の合計` = sum(!identified),
            `その割合` = sum(!identified) / B_ITER,
            `ベースラインが警告を出した反復` = n_distinct(iter[base_warn]),
            .groups = "drop")
id_by_n %>%
  kable(caption = paste("水準別の識別不能（すべて mgus の分離）。",
                        "反転確率は全水準で同一だが、mgus の陽性者数が",
                        "1 名から 96 名まで動くため摂動の実効的な破壊度は n に依存する。",
                        "初版は 5 抽出中 1 本が結果を支配していたが、本版は 1000 反復で平均される。"),
        digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r convergence}
cfr_tbl <- dp_tbl %>%
  distinct(level_idx, n_target, iter, epsilon, converged) %>%
  group_by(n_target, epsilon) %>%
  summarise(cfr = 1 - mean(converged), .groups = "drop")

eval_tbl <- dp_tbl %>%
  inner_join(baseline_tbl %>% select(level_idx, iter, variable, beta_base, se_base,
                                     z_base, p_base, estimable, identified, sig_base),
             by = c("level_idx", "iter", "variable")) %>%
  filter(identified, is.finite(beta_dp), is.finite(se_dp), se_dp > 0) %>%
  rename(conv = converged)

drop_tbl <- dp_tbl %>%
  inner_join(baseline_tbl %>% select(level_idx, iter, variable, identified),
             by = c("level_idx", "iter", "variable")) %>%
  filter(identified) %>%
  group_by(n_target, epsilon) %>%
  summarise(`摂動後に推定できなかった割合` = mean(!(is.finite(beta_dp) & is.finite(se_dp) & se_dp > 0)),
            .groups = "drop")

cfr_tbl %>% inner_join(drop_tbl, by = c("n_target", "epsilon")) %>%
  group_by(n_target) %>%
  summarise(`CFR 平均` = mean(cfr), `CFR 最大` = max(cfr),
            `摂動後に推定できなかった割合 最大` = max(`摂動後に推定できなかった割合`), .groups = "drop") %>%
  kable(caption = paste("水準別の収束失敗率（CFR）。CFR は coxph が警告を出した反復の割合",
                        "（既存規約では収束失敗として扱う）。右端はベースラインで識別された係数のうち",
                        "摂動後に推定値が得られなかったセルの割合。"), digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

stopifnot(!anyNA(cfr_tbl$cfr), all(drop_tbl$`摂動後に推定できなかった割合` < 0.05),
          nrow(eval_tbl) > 0, !anyNA(eval_tbl$p_dp))
cat(sprintf("摂動後に推定できなかったセルの割合は最大 %.4f。CFR（警告ベース）の最大は %.3f\n",
            max(drop_tbl$`摂動後に推定できなかった割合`), max(cfr_tbl$cfr)))
cat(sprintf("評価に使えるセル %s 件\n", format(nrow(eval_tbl), big.mark = ",")))
```

```{r metrics-ab}
per_iter <- function(dat, lab) {
  dat %>%
    group_by(level_idx, n_target, iter, epsilon) %>%
    summarise(
      k_ns  = sum(!sig_base), k_sig = sum(sig_base),
      fpr   = if (sum(!sig_base) > 0) mean(sig_dp[!sig_base]) else NA_real_,
      lsr   = if (sum(sig_base)  > 0) mean(!sig_dp[sig_base]) else NA_real_,
      .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(denominator = lab)
}

base_A <- eval_tbl %>% filter(identified)
base_B <- eval_tbl %>% filter(identified, variable %in% FIXED_DENOM)

iter_A <- per_iter(base_A, "A: 各反復で分母を引き直し")
iter_B <- per_iter(base_B, "B: 全データの非有意 3 係数に限定")

curve_of <- function(it) {
  it %>%
    filter(is.finite(epsilon)) %>%
    group_by(denominator, n_target, epsilon) %>%
    summarise(mean_fpr = mean(fpr, na.rm = TRUE), se_fpr = sd(fpr, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(fpr))),
              n_fpr = sum(!is.na(fpr)), mean_denom = mean(k_ns),
              mean_lsr = mean(lsr, na.rm = TRUE), se_lsr = sd(lsr, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(lsr))),
              n_lsr = sum(!is.na(lsr)), mean_denom_sig = mean(k_sig),
              .groups = "drop")
}
curves <- bind_rows(curve_of(iter_A), curve_of(iter_B))

EPS_FINITE <- sort(EPSILON_VALUES[is.finite(EPSILON_VALUES)])
curves <- curves %>% mutate(across(c(mean_fpr, mean_lsr, se_fpr, se_lsr), ~ ifelse(is.nan(.x), NA_real_, .x)))
stopifnot(
  nrow(curves) == 2L * length(N_LEVELS) * length(EPS_FINITE),
  !anyNA(curves$mean_fpr),
  all(curves$mean_fpr >= 0 & curves$mean_fpr <= 1),
  all(curves$n_fpr > 0.5 * B_ITER),
  all(is.na(curves$mean_lsr) == (curves$n_lsr == 0))
)
cat(sprintf("曲線テーブル %d 行（2 定義 × %d 水準 × %d ε）✅ 各点は最小 %d 反復の平均\n",
            nrow(curves), length(N_LEVELS), length(EPS_FINITE), min(curves$n_fpr)))
cat(sprintf("LSR の分母が空になるのは %d 行（%s）。設計上の帰結である\n",
            sum(curves$n_lsr == 0),
            paste(unique(sprintf("%s / n=%d", curves$denominator[curves$n_lsr == 0],
                                 curves$n_target[curves$n_lsr == 0])), collapse = ", ")))
```

```{r peaks}
EPS_MAX <- max(EPS_FINITE)
peak_of <- function(cv, col) {
  cv %>%
    rename(y = all_of(col)) %>%
    group_by(denominator, n_target) %>%
    summarise(
      plateau  = y[epsilon == min(EPS_FINITE)],
      peak     = max(y),
      peak_eps = min(epsilon[y == max(y)]),
      excess   = max(y) - plateau,
      half_lvl = plateau + (max(y) - plateau) / 2,
      eps_lo   = min(epsilon[y >= half_lvl]),
      eps_hi   = max(epsilon[y >= half_lvl]),
      fwhm_dec = log10(eps_hi) - log10(eps_lo),
      censored = max(epsilon[y >= half_lvl]) == EPS_MAX,
      mean_denom = mean(mean_denom),
      .groups = "drop")
}
peaks_fpr <- peak_of(curves, "mean_fpr") %>% mutate(metric = "FPR")
peaks_lsr <- peak_of(curves %>% filter(n_lsr > 0), "mean_lsr") %>% mutate(metric = "LSR")
peaks <- bind_rows(peaks_fpr, peaks_lsr)

stopifnot(nrow(peaks_fpr) == 2L * length(N_LEVELS), !anyNA(peaks$fwhm_dec),
          all(peaks$peak >= peaks$plateau))

peaks_fpr %>%
  select(denominator, n_target, mean_denom, plateau, peak, excess, peak_eps, fwhm_dec, censored) %>%
  arrange(denominator, n_target) %>%
  kable(caption = paste("偽陽性率のピーク高さ・位置・幅。excess はプラトーからの上振れ、",
                        "fwhm_dec はプラトーを基線とした半値全幅（ε の decade 数）。",
                        "censored = TRUE は右側が ε の格子の最終点で打ち切られており幅が下限であることを示す。"),
        digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

peaks_lsr %>%
  select(denominator, n_target, plateau, peak, excess, peak_eps) %>%
  arrange(denominator, n_target) %>%
  kable(caption = "有意性喪失率（LSR）の同じ量。低 ε ではほぼ全係数が有意性を失う。", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r rank-correlation}
rho_tbl <- peaks %>%
  group_by(metric, denominator) %>%
  filter(n() == length(N_LEVELS)) %>%
  summarise(
    rho = cor(n_target, peak, method = "spearman"),
    `p 値（厳密）` = suppressWarnings(
      cor.test(n_target, peak, method = "spearman", exact = TRUE)$p.value),
    `p 値（近似・参考）` = suppressWarnings(
      cor.test(n_target, peak, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$p.value),
    `95% 下限` = tanh(atanh(cor(n_target, peak, method = "spearman")) - 1.96 / sqrt(length(N_LEVELS) - 3)),
    `95% 上限` = tanh(atanh(cor(n_target, peak, method = "spearman")) + 1.96 / sqrt(length(N_LEVELS) - 3)),
    `逆転の数` = sum(diff(peak[order(n_target)]) < 0),
    .groups = "drop")
rho_tbl %>%
  kable(caption = paste("ピーク高さと n の順位相関（7 水準）。信頼区間は Fisher 変換による。",
                        "「逆転の数」は隣接水準で値が下がった箇所の数。"), digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
stopifnot(nrow(rho_tbl) >= 3L, !anyNA(rho_tbl$rho))
```

```{r peak-significance}
EPS_LO <- min(EPS_FINITE)
paired_tbl <- map_dfr(N_LEVELS, function(nn) {
  pe <- peaks_fpr$peak_eps[peaks_fpr$n_target == nn &
                             str_starts(peaks_fpr$denominator, "A:")]
  if (pe == EPS_LO) {
    return(tibble(n_target = nn, `ピーク ε` = pe, `対応のある反復数` = NA_integer_,
                  `上振れ 平均` = 0, `95% 下限` = NA_real_, `95% 上限` = NA_real_,
                  `p 値` = NA_real_))
  }
  w <- iter_A %>% filter(n_target == nn, epsilon %in% c(EPS_LO, pe), !is.na(fpr)) %>%
    select(iter, epsilon, fpr) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = epsilon, values_from = fpr) %>%
    drop_na()
  d <- w[[as.character(pe)]] - w[[as.character(EPS_LO)]]
  tt <- t.test(d)
  tibble(n_target = nn, `ピーク ε` = pe, `対応のある反復数` = length(d),
         `上振れ 平均` = mean(d), `95% 下限` = tt$conf.int[1], `95% 上限` = tt$conf.int[2],
         `p 値` = tt$p.value)
})
paired_tbl %>%
  kable(caption = paste("ピーク ε とプラトー（ε=0.1）の対応のある比較。",
                        "初版は 5 本の抽出しかなく n=168 の上振れが 0 と区別できなかった（p = 0.31）。"),
        digits = 5) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
stopifnot(nrow(paired_tbl) == length(N_LEVELS),
          all(is.na(paired_tbl$`p 値`) == (paired_tbl$`ピーク ε` == EPS_LO)))
```

```{r converged-only-sensitivity}
                      sens$signed_d[sens$n_target == max(N_LEVELS) & sens$epsilon == 100],
```

```{r metric-c}
rse_cell <- eval_tbl %>%
  filter(identified, is.finite(epsilon)) %>%
  mutate(r_se     = se_dp / se_base,
         shift_z  = (beta_dp - beta_base) / se_base,
         bias_b   = beta_dp - beta_base,
         z_eff    = beta_dp / se_dp)

rse_summary <- rse_cell %>%
  group_by(n_target, epsilon) %>%
  summarise(mean_rse = mean(r_se), median_rse = median(r_se), sd_rse = sd(r_se),
            max_rse = max(r_se), n_inflated = sum(r_se > RSE_INFLATED), n_cells = n(),
            .groups = "drop")

rse_summary %>%
  select(n_target, epsilon, mean_rse) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = n_target, values_from = mean_rse) %>%
  kable(caption = paste("r_SE の**平均**（反復 × 係数、識別済みセルのみ）。列が n、行が ε。",
                        "値が小さいほど SE が縮んでいる。"), digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

rse_summary %>%
  select(n_target, epsilon, median_rse) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = n_target, values_from = median_rse) %>%
  kable(caption = paste("同じ量の**中央値**。平均か中央値かを明示する。",
                        "係数の違いを調整していないこの中央値は、",
                        "低 ε では希少二値共変量 mgus の挙動に追随するため n とともに下がる。",
                        "係数の違いを調整した量は下の rse-normalized チャンクを参照。"), digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r rse-inflated}

n_gt1  <- sum(rse_agg$mean_rse > 1)
n_infl <- sum(rse_agg$mean_rse > RSE_INFLATED)
cat(sprintf("反復単位: r_SE > 1 のセルは %s / %s 件（%.1f%%）。1 回の摂動に基づくばらつきを含む。\n",
            format(sum(rse_cell$r_se > 1), big.mark = ","),
            format(nrow(rse_cell), big.mark = ","),
            100 * mean(rse_cell$r_se > 1)))

            nrow(rse_agg), n_gt1, RSE_INFLATED, n_infl))

rse_infl <- rse_agg %>% filter(mean_rse > RSE_INFLATED) %>% arrange(desc(mean_rse))
if (n_infl > 0) {
  rse_infl %>% head(20) %>%
    kable(caption = sprintf("平均 r_SE > %.1f（摂動後に SE が膨らんだ）セル（上位 20 行）", RSE_INFLATED),
          digits = 3) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
  MGUS_SHARE <- mean(rse_infl$variable == "mgus")
  gap_lo <- if (any(rse_agg$mean_rse > 1 & rse_agg$mean_rse <= RSE_INFLATED))
    max(rse_agg$mean_rse[rse_agg$mean_rse > 1 & rse_agg$mean_rse <= RSE_INFLATED]) else 1
  cat(sprintf("閾値の前後の隔たりは %.2f–%.2f。うち mgus が %.0f%%\n",
              gap_lo, min(rse_infl$mean_rse), 100 * MGUS_SHARE))
  stopifnot(MGUS_SHARE > 0.9)
} else {
  MGUS_SHARE <- NA_real_
  cat("平均で見ると SE が膨らむセルは 1 つも無い。初版で報告した 5 件は、抽出が 5 本しか無く",
      "1 本の外れ値が平均を支配していたことによる（本版は 1000 反復で平均される）\n")
}
cat(sprintf("反復単位で最大の r_SE は %.1f（%s・ε=%g・n=%d）\n",
            max(rse_cell$r_se),
            rse_cell$variable[which.max(rse_cell$r_se)],
            rse_cell$epsilon[which.max(rse_cell$r_se)],
```

```{r rse-regression}
cell_agg <- rse_cell %>%
  group_by(n_target, epsilon, variable) %>%
  summarise(r_se      = mean(r_se),
            se_base   = mean(se_base),
            beta_base = mean(abs(beta_base)),
            bias_b    = mean(bias_b),
            z_eff     = mean(abs(z_eff)),
            n_cells   = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(z_base  = beta_base / se_base,
         shift_z = bias_b / se_base)

slope_tbl <- function(dat) {
  map_dfr(EPS_FINITE, function(e) {
    d <- dat %>% filter(epsilon == e)
    m <- lm(log(r_se) ~ log(n_target) + variable, data = d)
    ci <- confint(m)["log(n_target)", ]
    tibble(epsilon = e, セル数 = nrow(d),
           `log(n) の係数` = unname(coef(m)["log(n_target)"]),
           `95% 下限` = ci[1], `95% 上限` = ci[2],
           `p 値` = summary(m)$coefficients["log(n_target)", 4])
  })
}
rse_slope        <- slope_tbl(cell_agg %>% filter(variable != "mgus"))
rse_slope_allvar <- slope_tbl(cell_agg)

rse_slope %>%
  kable(caption = paste("【主判定】ε ごとの log(r_SE) ~ log(n) + 係数固定効果（mgus を除く 6 係数）。",
                        "負の係数は「n が大きいほど SE がより縮む」を意味する（標本サイズ仮説の向き）。"),
        digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
rse_slope_allvar %>%
  kable(caption = paste("【感度分析】mgus を含めた 7 係数。ε=30 付近で係数と信頼区間が広がるのは",
                        "mgus の摂動後 SE の裾によるものであり、他の 6 係数には現れない。"), digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

NRATIO <- max(N_LEVELS) / min(N_LEVELS)
RSE_SLOPE_MAX       <- max(abs(rse_slope$`log(n) の係数`))
RSE_SLOPE_CI_MAX    <- max(abs(c(rse_slope$`95% 下限`, rse_slope$`95% 上限`)))
RSE_SLOPE_MAX_ALL   <- max(abs(rse_slope_allvar$`log(n) の係数`))
RSE_SLOPE_CI_ALL    <- max(abs(c(rse_slope_allvar$`95% 下限`, rse_slope_allvar$`95% 上限`)))
RSE_SIGN_POS        <- sum(rse_slope$`95% 下限` > 0)
RSE_SIGN_NEG        <- sum(rse_slope$`95% 上限` < 0)
pct <- function(s) 100 * (exp(s * log(NRATIO)) - 1)
cat(sprintf("【主判定・6 係数】|log(n) の係数| の最大 %.4f（点推定）/ %.4f（信頼区間の端）\n",
            RSE_SLOPE_MAX, RSE_SLOPE_CI_MAX))
cat(sprintf("  n を %.1f 倍にしたときの r_SE の変化: 点推定 %.1f%% / 信頼区間の端でも %.1f%%\n",
            NRATIO, pct(RSE_SLOPE_MAX), pct(RSE_SLOPE_CI_MAX)))
cat(sprintf("  信頼区間が 0 を含まない ε: 正の側 %d 個 / 負の側 %d 個（全 %d 個）。",
            RSE_SIGN_POS, RSE_SIGN_NEG, length(EPS_FINITE)))
cat("正の係数は「n が大きいほど SE の縮みが弱い」であり、標本サイズ仮説とは逆向きである\n")
cat(sprintf("【感度分析・7 係数】同 %.4f（点推定）/ %.4f（信頼区間の端）。mgus の裾を含むため広がる\n",
            RSE_SLOPE_MAX_ALL, RSE_SLOPE_CI_ALL))
stopifnot(nrow(rse_slope) == length(EPS_FINITE), RSE_SLOPE_CI_MAX < 0.2)
```

```{r channel-decomposition}
slope_of <- function(d, y) {
  ok <- is.finite(y)
  m <- lm(y[ok] ~ log(d$n_target[ok]) + d$variable[ok])
  unname(coef(m)[2])
}
channel_of <- function(dat) {
  map_dfr(EPS_FINITE, function(e) {
    d <- dat %>% filter(epsilon == e,
                        is.finite(log(se_base)), is.finite(log(z_base)),
                        is.finite(log(abs(shift_z))), is.finite(log(r_se)),
                        is.finite(log(abs(bias_b))), is.finite(log(z_eff)),
                        is.finite(log(beta_base)))
    tibble(epsilon = e, セル数 = nrow(d),
           `log(SE_base)`    = slope_of(d, log(d$se_base)),
           `log|z_base|`     = slope_of(d, log(d$z_base)),
           `log|s(ε)|`       = slope_of(d, log(abs(d$shift_z))),
           `log(r_SE)`       = slope_of(d, log(d$r_se)),
           `log|β バイアス|` = slope_of(d, log(abs(d$bias_b))),
           `log|β_base|`     = slope_of(d, log(d$beta_base)),
           `log|z_eff|`      = slope_of(d, log(d$z_eff)))
  })
}
channel        <- channel_of(cell_agg %>% filter(variable != "mgus"))
channel_allvar <- channel_of(cell_agg)

channel %>%
  kable(caption = paste("【主判定】各量の log を log(n) に回帰したときの傾き（mgus を除く 6 係数、",
                        "係数を固定効果として調整）。0.5 は √n 則、0 は n 非依存、",
                        "−0.5 は 1/√n での縮小を意味する。集計単位は (水準 × 係数)。"),
        digits = 3) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
channel_allvar %>%
  kable(caption = "【感度分析】mgus を含めた 7 係数", digits = 3) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

CH <- function(nm) median(channel[[nm]])
stopifnot(nrow(channel) == length(EPS_FINITE), !anyNA(channel$`log(r_SE)`))
cat(sprintf(paste0("中央値: log(SE_base) %.3f / log|z_base| %.3f / log|s(ε)| %.3f / log(r_SE) %.3f / ",
                   "log|β バイアス| %.3f / log|β_base| %.3f / log|z_eff| %.3f\n"),
            CH("log(SE_base)"), CH("log|z_base|"), CH("log|s(ε)|"), CH("log(r_SE)"),
            CH("log|β バイアス|"), CH("log|β_base|"), CH("log|z_eff|")))

stopifnot(
  length(unique(channel$セル数)) == 1L,
  channel$セル数[1] == length(N_LEVELS) * (length(VARS) - 1L),
  length(unique(channel_allvar$セル数)) == 1L,
  max(abs(channel$`log|s(ε)|` - channel$`log|β バイアス|` + channel$`log(SE_base)`)) < 1e-8,
  max(abs(channel$`log|z_base|` - channel$`log|β_base|` + channel$`log(SE_base)`)) < 1e-8
)
cat(sprintf("行集合の確認: 全 %d 個の ε で回帰の対象が %d セル（%d 水準 × %d 係数）で一定 ✅\n",
            length(EPS_FINITE), channel$セル数[1], length(N_LEVELS), length(VARS) - 1L))
cat("傾きの加法性も成立するが、これは s と z_base の定義からの代数的な帰結であり、",
    "6 本の回帰が同じ行集合を見ていることの確認にすぎない。\n")
cat("**「n の入口は SE_base による除算だけ」の根拠は、この関係ではなく",
    "r_SE の傾きが 0 に近いという別個の測定である。**\n")
```

```{r metric-d}
z_slope <- baseline_tbl %>%
  filter(identified) %>%
  group_by(n_target, variable) %>%
  summarise(z = mean(abs(z_base)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(セル数 = n(),
            `log|z_base| ~ log(n) の傾き` = unname(coef(lm(log(z) ~ log(n_target)))[2]),
            `決定係数` = summary(lm(log(z) ~ log(n_target)))$r.squared,
            `|z_base| at n=168` = z[n_target == 168L],
            `|z_base| at n=6524` = z[n_target == max(N_LEVELS)],
            .groups = "drop")
z_slope %>%
  kable(caption = paste("ベースライン Wald 統計量の n 依存（√n 則なら傾き 0.5）。",
                        "各点は 1000 反復の平均。"), digits = 3) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("係数ごとの傾きの中央値 = %.3f（経路分解のプール回帰では %.3f）\n",
            median(z_slope$`log|z_base| ~ log(n) の傾き`), CH("log|z_base|")))
```

```{r nsr-check}
cont_vars <- names(TYPES)[unlist(TYPES) == "continuous"]
nsr_var <- sd_tbl %>%
  group_by(src_var) %>%
  summarise(`sd(X) 最小` = min(sd_x), `sd(X) 最大` = max(sd_x),
            `最大 / 最小` = max(sd_x) / min(sd_x),
            `変動係数` = sd(sd_x) / mean(sd_x), .groups = "drop")
nsr_trend <- sd_tbl %>%
  group_by(src_var, n_target) %>% summarise(sd_x = mean(sd_x), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(src_var) %>%
  summarise(`水準平均の最大 / 最小` = max(sd_x) / min(sd_x),
            `rho(n, sd(X) の水準平均)` = cor(n_target, sd_x, method = "spearman"),
            `p 値` = suppressWarnings(
              cor.test(n_target, sd_x, method = "spearman", exact = TRUE)$p.value),
            .groups = "drop")
nsr_var %>% inner_join(nsr_trend, by = "src_var") %>%
  kable(caption = paste("nsr は b が固定されているため sd(X) と反比例する。",
                        "個々の部分標本の間では最大 3 倍前後動くが、**水準平均には n との",
                        "系統的な傾向がない**（順位相関の p 値を参照）。",
                        "個々のばらつきは 1000 反復の平均で打ち消される。"), digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

NSR_TREND_MAX_RHO <- max(abs(nsr_trend$`rho(n, sd(X) の水準平均)`))
NSR_TREND_MIN_P   <- min(nsr_trend$`p 値`)
NSR_LEVEL_RATIO   <- max(nsr_trend$`水準平均の最大 / 最小`)
NSR_CELL_RATIO    <- max(nsr_var$`最大 / 最小`)
stopifnot(nrow(sd_tbl) == length(N_LEVELS) * B_ITER * length(cont_vars),
          !anyNA(sd_tbl$sd_x), all(sd_tbl$sd_x > 0))
cat(sprintf("個々の部分標本の間で sd(X) は最大 %.2f 倍動く（したがって nsr も同じだけ動く）。\n",
            NSR_CELL_RATIO))
cat(sprintf("水準平均どうしでは最大 %.3f 倍にとどまる。水準平均と n の順位相関は絶対値で最大 %.3f（最小 p = %.4f）。\n",
            NSR_LEVEL_RATIO, NSR_TREND_MAX_RHO, NSR_TREND_MIN_P))
if (NSR_TREND_MIN_P < 0.05) {
  cat("→ 水準平均に n との関係が検出された変数がある。上表の該当変数と倍率を報告書に明記すること。\n")
} else {
  cat("→ 水準平均に n との系統的な関係は検出されない（すべての変数で p >= 0.05）。\n")
}
cat("いずれにせよ「ノイズ対分散比を固定した」とは書けない。書けるのは",
    "「Laplace ノイズのスケール b と反転確率を固定した」までである。\n")

cat(sprintf("ε の格子の隣接間隔（decade）: 最小 %.3f / 最大 %.3f。ピークの位置と高さはこの格子に量子化される\n",
            min(diff(log10(EPS_FINITE))), max(diff(log10(EPS_FINITE)))))
```
